instruction.text: Schaue dir das Bild an und beantworte die Fragen.
Lies den Text über Lisa und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: I wake up at 7 o'clock. I eat a sandwich and drink water for breakfast. I don't eat eggs and bacon. I get dressed and I pack my school bag. Then I go to school at 8 o'clock.
atoms.sound: I wake up at 7 o'clock. I eat a sandwich and drink water for breakfast. I don't eat eggs and bacon. I get dressed and I pack my school bag. Then I go to school at 8 o'clock.

atoms.a: What does Lisa eat for breakfast?

atoms.text: My favourite subject is maths. I also like sport, because I can run fast. But I don't like music, because I can't sing.
